features.name: Marian Spencer Statue
features.description: The Marian A. Spencer statue is Cincinnati's first public statue of a named woman, installed in 2021 in the Women's Garden at Smale Riverfront Park to honor the Cincinnati civil-rights leader and public servant.

details.positionQuality: Exact Wikidata position for the named Marian Spencer statue in Smale Riverfront Park's Women's Garden, corroborated by Cincinnati Parks
details.imageAlt: Bronze statue of Marian Spencer greeting two children in Smale Riverfront Park's Women's Garden
